derivative.comment: the derive integer defines which derivate to get, 0=none, 1= first, 2 = second etc, if append is set to true the derivatives will be appended to the original bands; this is not recommended but can be used to explore which is more significant, the orignal bands or the derivatives, and then select only one for the coninued modeling.

scatter_correction.comment: scattercorrection can apply the following: norm-1 (l1), norm-2 (l2) norm-max (max), snv (snv) or msc (msc). If two are given they will be done in series using output from the first as input to the second

scaling.comment: Spectral scaling method options: meancentring, autoscaling, paretoscaling and poissonscaling

decomposition.comment: Decomposition as a spectral compression/preparation process, method options: pca
